request: Email invoice INV-000001 to Lethbridge Millwork.

answer:
I can't email invoice INV-000001 to Lethbridge Millwork. The ERP has no way to email or send documents to anyone. I didn't change anything.

For invoices, the ERP can only post, void, record a payment against an invoice or issue a credit. To get the invoice to Lethbridge Millwork, you'll need to send it from your own email.
